Nuptrila_Padded_Forelimbs.description: Husky, heavily-muscled forearms terminating in specialized digits bearing nuptial pads - swollen, keratinous glands that secrete sticky mucus. They provide a vice-like, inescapable grip on wet, struggling targets and slippery surfaces.

Webbed_Natatorial_Arms.description: Slender, cartilaginous arms ending in fully webbed, elongated digits. While somewhat clumsy on dry land for fine manipulation, they act as highly efficient pectoral oars when fully submerged.
